title: Lines Held Over While a Credit Claim Stands in Review
content:
Where the client disputes a line on a Private Event & Banquet Services final bill, the undisputed balance falls due on the ordinary terms and only the disputed line is held over. What is held over comes off what the client settles, and it is settled by the credit claims standing in review on the booking in the event request log and by whether the dispute window is still open.

1. Where a credit claim on the booking stands in review in the event request log and the dispute window is still open, the audio-visual package and the dance floor charge printed against the package are both held over.
2. Where a credit claim on the booking stands in review in the event request log and the dispute window has closed, the audio-visual package printed against the package alone is held over.
3. Where no credit claim on the booking stands in review, nothing is held over.

The dispute window is still open where the calendar days run from the day the window runs from up to today do not exceed the dispute window printed against the package; a day count standing exactly at that window is still open.

## The figures each package prints

| Package | Audio-visual package, USD | Dance floor charge, USD | Dispute window, calendar days | Held over while open, USD | Held over once closed, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 125 | 0 | 10 | 125 | 125 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 0 | 14 | 450 | 450 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 850 | 650 | 21 | 1500 | 850 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2400 | 1200 | 30 | 3600 | 2400 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 4800 | 1500 | 21 | 6300 | 4800 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A booking on the Seated Banquet Package carries one credit claim standing in review, and 12 days have run from the day the window runs from. 12 does not exceed the 21 days the package prints, so 850 and 650 together, that is 1500, are held over. Once 22 days have run the window has closed, and 850 alone is held over. Where every claim on the booking stands approved, declined or withdrawn rather than in review, nothing is held over.
